samples.question: The gray line in this picture is one single continuous pipe that never branches and never touches itself. One end of the pipe sits inside the orange ring. Three colored squares - one blue, one red and one purple - sit on top of the pipe at three different places along it. Start at the end of the pipe inside the orange ring and walk along the pipe itself, following every bend, until you reach the far end. Straight-line distance across the picture does not matter; only distance travelled along the pipe counts. Which colored square do you reach first? Answer blue, red, or purple.
